items.title: 67255_Helen Humes oral history interview
items.q: Interviewer mentions Gus Johnson commenting on a pianist; Interviewee responds with general knowledge about where people live and speculates on Gus's past associations ('I think he went earlier with Benny Carter'), but provides no evidence of a direct personal or professional relationship between he

ctx.x: I think it was Gus Johnson who was saying to me that, oh there's a nice pianist with glasses, and he's got a brother in the business. A thoughtful pianist.
They live out here don't they?
